chatgptBuildFacts.source: ChatGPT production JS: manifest 4da31bb4 (fetched 2026-09-26) and manifest 4ad86f39 (the build of the operator's page export, fetched 2026-09-28 from chatgpt.com/cdn/assets; its 202 manifest chunks searched)
chatgptBuildFacts.virtualizedThread: The conversation thread (ChatGptConversationPage: 220161.ed17907c1b.js in 4da31bb4, 585283.3ac935c18a.js in 4ad86f39) renders turns through a virtual list (module iBd: 705811.c957aabea2.js / 808993.1cb7ebf73d.js) with {entries, gapPx:6, RowComponent, getBottomScrollPaddingPx, preserveMeasuredTurnViewport}. The list keeps only entries.slice(startIndex,endIndex) in the DOM (rows div[data-turn-key]); the window is the turns intersecting the viewport plus overscanCount 2, default viewportHeightPx 800, unmeasured turn height estimatedHeightPx??280. A turn row holds the user message and the answer.
chatgptBuildFacts.collapsedUserMessage: A user message is rendered in a collapsible wrapper (module YW / 858350.5685ce98c3.js, collapsedLineCount default 20): the full text stays in the DOM inside an overflow-hidden max-height box, followed by … and a show-more button while collapsed.

change.rootCause: v1.8.10 proved the sent user turn by DOM count (receipt: userCount = baseline + 1 with a new id), by DOM ordinal (expected index = baselineUserCount) or by the user text hash. In the virtualized thread the DOM user count stops at the window size, so after the send it stayed at the baseline (5), the expected ordinal 5 was past the window, and the collapsed message text (full text + '…') never hashed to the prompt. waitForMaterialization therefore acknowledged by GENERATION_STARTED without a receipt, and every 30 s re-check held DISPATCH_EFFECT_UNRESOLVED; exact-once forbids a resend. Reproduced in Chromium with the v1.8.10 scripts on a page built to the build facts (tools/verify-virtualized-thread-dispatch.mjs: 5/12; send result identical to the diagnostics: acknowledged, GENERATION_STARTED, no receipt; ordinal 5 unresolved; the shifted ordinal resolves the previous turn). That the operator's hidden tab held exactly five unmeasured turns is an inference from the code and the counts, not a measurement.
change.fix: The prompt's own A2A messageId (a random id per prompt, JSON.stringify envelope) is its causal marker. lib/turn-causality.mjs: promptCausalMarker, expectedPromptMarker, proof AUTONOMOUS_USER_TURN_MARKER_MATCH (only for a resolution echoing the same marker). content.js: resolveAutonomousTurn resolves the one user message whose text contains the marker (resolvedBy PROMPT_MARKER; two matches resolve nothing; no ordinal guess on the app shell when a marker is given); the materialization receipt uses it (resolvedBy PROMPT_MARKER, promptMarker) whatever the count. background.js: the dispatch record stores promptMarker and baselineLastUserId; the send and every expected-turn page-state request (also restart recovery) carry the marker; the receipt handler accepts marker receipts only for the pending prompt's marker and never the turn before the send; lib/send-fence.mjs: the marker in the thread before a send is PAGE_PROMPT_MARKER (no second send). A process already held in DISPATCH_EFFECT_UNRESOLVED resolves at the next re-check after the bridge refresh, without a resend.

operatorActions.readResponse: EIC_GF_OPERATOR_READ_RESPONSE ('Läs svar' on the worker card): SENDING with an effect-possible dispatch is reconciled at once (the 30 s DISPATCH_EFFECT_UNRESOLVED wait is skipped); if the user turn still cannot be proven, the page's newest user turn is bound when it is newer than the previous Greenfield turn and the dispatch baseline and the conversation matches (dispatch.operatorOverride, materializedBy OPERATOR, carried to lastPrompt); WAITING is read at once. Never resends; other holds are not bypassed; the panel asks before a SENDING read.
operatorActions.nextQueueItem: EIC_GF_OPERATOR_NEXT_QUEUE_ITEM ('Gå till nästa uppgift i kön'): from SENDING, WAITING or PAUSED the slot is parked with its checkpoint (as the 120-minute stale rotation: unanswered turn not counted, resume previousDisposition OPERATOR_QUEUE_ADVANCE, sourceResponseState from the process: PROMPT_EFFECT_UNKNOWN / PROMPT_ACKNOWLEDGED_NO_COMPLETED_RESPONSE / ...), the dispatch hold stays with the abandoned conversation, a requested mission pause stays on the slot, and the next runnable slot starts in a fresh chat; QUEUE_WAIT wakes the queue; with no other runnable slot nothing changes. Never BLOCKED, nothing resent, the panel asks first and suggests 'Läs svar' for an unread answer.

claimBoundary.threadBehaviour: derived from ChatGPT's production JS (manifests 4da31bb4 and 4ad86f39) and reproduced on a synthetic page; how many turns a live tab keeps in the DOM depends on viewport height, tab visibility and message lengths
claimBoundary.readResponseBinding: 'Läs svar' binds the newest user turn after the previous Greenfield turn; if the operator typed a message in that tab after Greenfield's prompt, that message's turn is bound
claimBoundary.packageIntegrity: INTEGRITY.json binds packaged bytes; not a code-correctness proof

knownRemainingRisks: ChatGPT can change its thread again; the marker needs the user message text (with the A2A messageId) to stay in the DOM, which holds while ChatGPT collapses by CSS height

If the operator scrolls the managed tab so that the newest turn leaves the render window, neither the marker nor an id can be found until it is scrolled back; 'Läs svar' then reports that no new user turn is visible
A prompt whose text is not an A2A envelope has no marker and falls back to v1.8.10's count/ordinal/hash proofs
'Gå till nästa uppgift i kön' abandons an unread answer in the old conversation (the parked mission is told its last prompt's effect is unknown); the operator is asked and pointed to 'Läs svar' first
Observation (not changed): the continuation objective sent to ChatGPT was cut at about 250 characters in two prompts of the reported conversation; the model noticed it
Discovery relies on the sidebar's Recents containing at least one EIC conversation (v1.8.9)
A stuck stop/streaming signal can consume grace up to v1.8.8's fixed four-hour cap
